text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — Banyan Retail reached out wanting to onboard a custom ranking model for product search. Key asks: Dedicated deployment (data residency), no persistent KV cache for queries containing PII, run evals on ~50k sample queries, and they want an initial SLA conversation (they're worried about renewal due to budget). They shared a sample dataset link: https://files.banyanretail.com/samples/ranking_preview.csv :eyes:
Oleg (eng): Thanks. Do we have model artifact details? size / framework / quantization target? Dedicated is fine but need numbers to plan GPU allocation and whether we can keep fine-grained isolation. Also: disabling prefix/KV cache will bump token cost, call that out to customer.
Maya (CS): They said it's a 13B transformer, PyTorch, aiming for 4-bit quantized, but they want us to verify perf.
Devon (SE): Ok — plan: spin a canary on a dedicated dev pool, run throughput + latency sweep with batch sizes 1..8, and run the 50k eval for ranking NDCG / MRR + hallucination detectors. Need their explicit PII redaction policy before we run any customer data on shared infra.
Priya (PM): I'll add a renewal-risk flag to the account. Their usage spiked in last quarter but legal flagged budget constraints for next year — if onboarding costs look high they might postpone renewal. Can we provide a cost estimate matrix (latency tiers x batching x quantization)?
Oleg (eng): I'll put together a perf/cost matrix. Quick note: with KV cache disabled, expected per-token GPU seconds go up ~1.6x for this architecture. If they accept a private Dedicated pool we can still enable ephemeral caching with TTL 0 for privacy-sensitive requests.
Maya (CS): Customer asked if we can run the evals in their Dedicated pool in their VPC — they prefer that.
Devon (SE): That's doable, but needs handoff to infra for VPC peering and for the Dedicated reservation. I'll draft the runbook: canary job, eval harness, rollouts.
SafetyBot: auto-scan -> safety intake required: create safety ticket CS-8241 for bias / hallucination / PII redaction checks.
Maya (CS): I'll request their internal redaction script and sample failure cases. Also asked for an enablement session for their MLops team next week.
Priya (PM): Schedule a 45m enablement: demo deployment flow + cost controls + rollback policy. We should include billing estimate and renewal timeline.
Oleg (eng): Quick blockers: need model weights access, sample queries, and confirmation on whether we should run evals on cleartext or masked samples. Also, which region do they prefer? APAC or US-west?
Maya (CS): They prefer US-west for latency. I'll follow up on masking and get weights access link.
DeployBot: created ticket TKT-3319: dedicated-provisioning-banyan, assigned to eng-infra.
Devon (SE): I'll start the eval harness once we have masked samples. Can someone create a temporary dedicated dev pool with same GPU family as planned prod?
Oleg (eng): I'll request a dev pool (same family) and tag it banyan-canary.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — I'll update Banyan with proposed timeline: perf/cost matrix in 48h, canary + eval within 5 business days after weights + masked samples, enablement session proposed next Thu 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): Marked as high-priority renewal watch. I'll follow up with account exec for commercial options.
Maya (CS): Filing this as the root thread for onboarding coordination. Adding notes to the customer record and linking tickets once infra confirms.
